 LAS VEGAS (KSNV) — Carrot Top is returning to the stage at the Luxor in Las Vegas on Oct. 19, following a September hospitalization after a reported suicide attempt.
 The comedian and actor, whose real name is Scott Christopher Thompson, announced the date on his social media account, thanking people for their support. 
 I’m truly overwhelmed by the outpouring of love, support, prayers, and well wishes I’ve received over the past couple of weeks. Every message, text, and kind thought has meant more to me than you know. While I haven’t been able to respond to everyone individually, please know that I’ve felt your love and appreciate each and every one of you from the bottom of my heart. Thank you for being there for me during this time. It truly means the world to me! The residency began in 1995, and it has been running since 2005 at the Atrium Showroom at the Luxor Hotel and Casino.
